ITEM 1 | Irregular piece, about 7 x 8 cm, sitting at the right edge of the plate. Exterior is dark brown and charred in streaks, with a ridged, striated surface. Right edge shows a pale cream-beige interior with a flaky, layered look. Little visible moisture or sheen; appears firm and dry. Sits directly on the plate beside a green slice. | 55

ITEM 2 | Thin round slice, about 3 cm across, with bright green skin along the outer edge and a paler greenish-cream flesh. Tucked against the underside of item 1, with a slightly glossy, moist look. | 8

ITEM 3 | Tiny crumb-like fragment, about 0.5 cm, light tan with a slightly darker edge, lying just left of item 1 on the plate. Dry and crumbly. | 1
